Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Series ordering,
permissions and around-Reel episode windows remain in sequences 35–36. Publication/index completion belongs to process 4.0. Store updates apply to write requests; query requests build a
permitted window without those writes.
